question: Avery attacks with a [Guile] that was turned face-down by [Ixidron], and Nelson blocks with [Jerrard of the Closed Fist]. Does Avery shuffle?
answer_gold:
Yes. By default, triggered abilities are checked immediately after the event in question to see if they should trigger. At that point, the Guile is face-up in the graveyard and has that ability.

(Guile's trigger does not fit the exception for "leaves-the-battlefield" triggers because it is a "from anywhere" trigger.)

question: Archer attacks with a [The Scarab God] that was turned face-down by [Ixidron] and Nia blocks with [Scathe Zombies]. Does The Scarab God trigger?
answer_gold: No. By default, triggered abilities are checked immediately after the event in question to see if they should trigger. However, "leaves-the-battlefield" triggers check the game state immediately before the event instead. At that point, The Scarab God had no abilities.

question: Alaia casts [Biogenic Upgrade] targeting [Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11]. In total how many counters are be placed on Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11?
answer_gold: Nine. Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11's ability is a replacement effect that applies whenever counters are being placed on it When Biogenic Upgrade begins resolving, that replacement effect will add a counter, resulting in Alaia placing four +1/+1 counters. Afterwards, Biogenic Upgrade will then double the amount of counters on Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11. This results in an additional four counters being placed on it, which will then be modified by Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11's replacement effect again, resulting in nine +1/+1 counters in total.

question: Addison casts [Ferocious Zheng]. After it resolves, they cast [Elemental Eruption] and reveal [Everdream] from their hand, splicing it onto Elemental Eruption. When Elemental Eruption's Storm trigger resolves, will the copies of Elemental Eruption also have Everdream spliced onto them?
answer_gold: Yes. As Addison is casting Elemental Eruption they choose whether they want to splice as part of the casting process. When the storm trigger resolves it copies all the choices made when casting the original spell, including the choice to splice.

question: Nova controls a [Torsten Von Ursus] enchanted by their [Felidar Umbra]. Allen activates the last ability of [Sorin, Lord of Innistrad], targeting the Torsten Von Ursus. What happens?
answer_gold: The Felidar Umbra is destroyed instead of the Torsten Von Ursus. It is then returned to the battlefield by the rest of Sorin, Lord of Innistrad's ability. The only creature on the battlefield is the Torsten Von Ursus, so the Felidar Umbra must enter the battlefield enchanting the Torsten Von Ursus. Felidar Umbra is now controlled by Allen.

question: Nico controls [Containment Priest]. Alma attempts to play [Dryad Arbor], which is exiled. Can Alma now play [Sequestered Stash] as their land for turn?
answer_gold: No. Regardless of what zone Dryad Arbor moved to, it was still played as Alma's land play, and Alma can only play one land each turn.

question: Norah controls [Blood Sun]. Ari plays [Dark Depths] and then destroys the Blood Sun with [Sultai Charm]. What happens?
answer_gold: Dark Depths entered the battlefield with no ice counters, since it didn't have the ability that would cause it to enter with them. When Blood Sun is destroyed, Dark Depths triggers since it has no ice counters on it and creates a Marit Lage token.

question: Alec controls [Elspeth Conquers Death] and puts the third lore counter it. With the triggered ability, they target [Eternal Witness] in their graveyard. When Eternal Witness returns to the battlefield, can it target Elspeth Conquers Death with its trigger?
answer_gold:
Yes.

When the final chapter ability resolves, Eternal Witness is returned to the battlefield. However, its triggered ability is not put onto the stack until after state based actions are checked. When state based actions are checked, Elspeth Conquers Death is sacrificed because is has a number of lore counters greater than or equal to its final chapter number. After this, triggers are placed onto the stack, and Elspeth Conquers Death is in the graveyard able to be the target of Eternal Witness's triggered ability.

question: Autumn attacks with [Robber of the Rich], exiling [Light Up the Stage] from Nehemiah's library. Can Autumn pay Light Up the Stage's Spectacle cost with only {C}?
answer_gold:
Yes.

Robber of the Rich allows Autumn to cast the card and "may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell." This changes how the player may pay a cost, and they can do so with any mana, regardless of color. 

"Spectacle" is an alternative cost ([702.137a]), and can only be used if no other alternative cost is being paid. Luckily, Robber of the Rich does not create an alternative cost, it just changes how mana may be spent.

question: Aiden controls [Volrath's Shapeshifter] and [Yixlid Jailer]. The top card of their graveyard is [Mistform Skyreaver]. Does Volrath's Shapeshifter have flying?
answer_gold: Yes. Yixlid Jailer only removes abilities, not text, and text is what Volrath's Shapeshifter cares about. Volrath's Shapeshifter also gains the text of the Mistform Skyreaver before Yixlid Jailer removes the abilities.

question: Autumn controls [Bridge from Below] and [Silvercoat Lion]. They cast [Hour of Revelation]. Do they create a Zombie token?
answer_gold: No. Leaves-the-battlefield triggers care about the state of the game immediately before the event in question. Bridge from Below was on the battlefield at that time, and won't trigger.

question: Axl activates [Ring of Ma'rûf]'s ability in their upkeep. What happens in Axl's draw step if they don't own any cards outside the game?
answer_gold: Axl is required to attempt to find a card from outside the game, if they fail to find one, then when the ability resolves they will put nothing into their hand. Since Ring of Ma'rûf sets up a replacement effect, Axl can't choose to ignore it.

question: Athena control [Krark, the Thumbless] and [Spark Double] copying it. They cast [Song of Totentanz], which triggers both Krark, the Thumbless. When the first trigger resolves they lose the flip and return Song of Totentanz to hand. What happens when the second trigger resolves?
answer_gold: If Athena loses the flip, nothing happens. If Athena wins the flip, a copy of Song of Totentanz is created.

question: Alden cast [Ixidron]. Natalie controls a very cute [Tangled Florahedron]. What happens to it?
answer_gold: Nothing. Tangled Florahedron cannot be turned face down.

question: Amani controls [Leyline of the Void] and casts [Hypnotic Cloud] to have Nicolas discard a card. Nicolas discards [Loxodon Smiter]. Does it end up on the battlefield or in exile?
answer_gold: Whichever Nicolas prefers. There are two replacement effects applying to Loxodon Smiter going to the graveyard. Nicolas is the controller of the affected object, so they choose where it ends up.

question: In a Commander game with 4 players, Ari casts [Kardur, Doomscourge]. Bode controls [Oxidda Finisher], and [Parhelion II], which is not a creature at the time Kardur, Doomscourge's enter the battlefield ability resolves. During Bode's next turn, can they attack Ari with Parhelion II? Can they have the Angel tokens created by Parhelion II attack Ari?
answer_gold:
Bode cannot attack Ari with Parhelion II, but they can choose for the Angel tokens to attack Ari.

Kardur, Doomscourge's enters-the-battlefield ability sets up a rules change that causes any creatures Ari's opponents control to have to attack if able and to have to attack another player if able. Since this is a change in the rules of the game, it affects Parhelion II even if it is not a creature at the time the ability resolves.

The Angel tokens are created attacking, but are never declared as attackers. Because of this, Bode can choose Ari to be the defending player for the tokens.

question: Aislinn controls two [Bramblewood Paragon]s and casts [Thunder-Thrash Elder]. What is the maximum amount of counters Thunder-Thrash Elder can enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Eight. Both Bramblewood Paragon and Thunder-Thrash Elder have replacement effects that modify how Thunder-Thrash Elder enters the battlefield. While Thunder-Thrash Elder is entering the battlefield the game checks which replacement effects to apply, and sees that there are two Bramblewood Paragons that want to place an additional +1/+1 counter on Thunder-Thrash Elder as well as a Devour ability. If Aislinn chooses to devour the Bramblewood Paragons, they will place an additional six +1/+1 counters on Thunder-Thrash Elder.

question: Nico controls [Urza's Saga] with two lore counters on it. Alexzander uses [Jinx] to change its land type. What happens?
answer_gold:
In layer 4, Urza's Saga will have its land type overwritten as well as lose all of its chapter abilities. It will gain the abilities to tap for {C} and to create Construct tokens in layer 6, as those abilities are granted by a continuous effect that was generated when the previous chapter abilities resolved..

Because Urza's Saga has lost all of its chapter abilities while still being a Saga, it is immediately sacrificed the next time state-based actions are checked, per the Urza's Saga ruling "If Urza's Saga loses all of its chapter abilities but is still a Saga, perhaps due to a card like Blood Moon, it will immediately be sacrificed".

gold_corrected.reason: original gold contradicted Urza's Saga ruling #1 (Scryfall)

question: Is [Umori, the Collector] a legal companion for a deck containing only [Grist, the Hunger Tide], creatures, and lands?
answer_gold: Yes. Grist, the Hunger Tide's ability is in effect even before the game begins..

question: Abel crews their [Adrestia]. Nathalie activates their [Mobilized District] causing it to become a creature. After that resolves, Nathalie casts [Mirrorweave] targeting their Mobilized District. What are Adrestia's characteristics after Mirrorweave resolves?
answer_gold:
It's a 0/0 colorless land artifact creature with no subtypes and the abilities of Mobilized District.

When Adrestia becomes a copy of Mobilized District, it copies only the copiable values of the permanent, which does not include continuous effects like the one turning Mobilized District into a creature.

The effect from crew is still making Adrestia an artifact creature ([702.122a]), but it doesn't define a power and toughness, so the game treats it as 0/0.

question: Ari controls a [Lunarch Inquisitors] that exiled a [Jasmine Boreal] when it transformed. Nyla casts [Moonmist]. Does the Jasmine Boreal return to the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Whenever a card refers to itself by name, it just means "this object". The exiled creature will return to the battlefield only when the permanent that was Lunarch Inquisitors leaves the battlefield, regardless of which face it was on at that time.

question: Addison controls [Carth the Lion] and [Bioessence Hydra]. Addison activates the [+1] ability of [Dovin, Architect of Law]. How many times does Bioessence Hydra trigger?
answer_gold: Once. If a planeswalker's ability has multiple costs to add or remove loyalty counters, those costs are combined into a single cost.

question: Nico casts [Assert Authority] targeting Ainsley's [Blightsteel Colossus]. What happens as Assert Authority resolves?
answer_gold: Blightsteel Colossus will be countered and exiled. Because Assert Authority has a self-replacement effect, it has to be chosen first before Blightsteel Colossus's replacement effect. Because Blightsteel Colossus is no longer going to the graveyard, its replacement effect can no longer apply.

question: Amani has 3 life. Briar casts [Chain of Plasma], targeting Amani. As it resolves, Amani pays the cost to copy it, and chooses to have the copy target Campbell. What happens?
answer_gold: The copy is put onto the stack targeting Campbell. Then the original Chain of Plasma finishes resolving and state-based actions are checked. Amani loses the game, and the copy of Chain of Plasma is removed from the stack before it would resolve.

question: In a multiplayer game, Achilles uses [Jon Irenicus, Shattered One] to give [Vastwood Gorger] to Brynn. If Brynn dies, what happens to Vastwood Gorger?
answer_gold: Achilles gets their Vastwood Gorger back. When Brynn leaves the game, any effects giving them control of any objects end.

question: Aspen attacks with [Hammers of Moradin]. During the combat damage step, they use [Time Stop] to end the turn. What happens to the tokens created by myriad?
answer_gold: They remain on the battlefield, and will be exiled at the beginning of the next end of combat step. ([702.116a], [511.2], [603.7b])

question: If Avery is going first, they'd like to reveal [Umori, the Collector] as their companion. If they're going second, they don't want to have a companion. Can they do this?
answer_gold: Yes. Starting player is determined before Avery would need to reveal their companion.

question: Aspen casts [Greater Good] sacrificing their [Bane Alley Blackguard] which is enchanted with [Mystic Subdual]. How many cards do they draw?
answer_gold: None. Greater Good checks the power of the creature on the battlefield, not in the graveyard. If a player is instructed to draw a negative number of cards, they draw 0.

question: Ari controls [Mana Reflection] and [Looming Spires]. Nicole controls [Damping Sphere]. If Ari taps the Looming Spires for mana, how much mana is produced, and of what type(s)?
answer_gold: {C}. As the ability resolves, Mana Reflection replaces "Add {R}" with "Add {R}{R}". Damping Sphere then applies and replaces that with "Add {C}". Mana Reflection won't apply again.

question: Ada controls [Ethersworn Canonist]. They want to suspend [Shade of Trokair] and then cast [Divination]. Can they?
answer_gold: Yes. Suspending a card is not casting a spell, so it does not count towards Ethersworn Canonist's restriction.

question: Natasha and Nico are playing Two-Headed Giant, and each controls their own copy of [Bloodbond Vampire]. Ariel controls [Wall of Shards], and on their next upkeep they put the third age counter on it. Can Ariel have Natasha gain one life and Nico gain two? If so, how many triggered abilities of Bloodbond Vampire will be put on the stack?
answer_gold: Paying Wall of Shards' cumulative upkeep involves the choice of an opponent. The choice for each age counter is made individually, then the whole cost is paid at once. This means Ariel can make the stated choice, and the result of this is Natasha gains one life and Nico gains two life. Because of this, each player's Bloodbond Vampire will trigger separately, causing two instances of the triggered ability to be put on the stack. Although the players share a life total, gaining life happens to each player individually.

question: Nataly controls [Urza's Saga] with 2 lore counters on it. Alex casts [Magus of the Moon]. What does Urza's Saga look like?
answer_gold: It's an Enchantment Land - Mountain Saga with "{T} add {R}.", the abilities to tap for {C} and to create Constructs that it gained from its already-resolved chapter I and II triggers (those are granted by continuous effects, so they survive the subtype change per the Urza's Saga ruling "Urza's Saga gains an ability from its first and second chapters. It keeps those abilities for as long as it's on the battlefield"), and no chapter abilities. Because it has lost all of its chapter abilities while still being a Saga, it is immediately sacrificed the next time state-based actions are checked, per the Urza's Saga ruling "If Urza's Saga loses all of its chapter abilities but is still a Saga, perhaps due to a card like Blood Moon, it will immediately be sacrificed". Magus of the Moon has the same effect here as Blood Moon, which that ruling names explicitly.

gold_corrected.reason: original gold contradicted Urza's Saga ruling #1 (Scryfall); also omitted the chapter-granted abilities that survive per ruling #5

question: Niko controls [Metallurgeon] and [Ornithopter of Paradise]. Avery casts [Prismari Command], choosing the "deal 2 damage" and "destroy target artifact" modes, targeting Ornithopter of Paradise with both. In response, Niko activates Metallurgeon's ability targeting Ornithopter of Paradise. What happens?
answer_gold: Ornithopter of Paradise will end up tapped and have no damage marked on it. Metallurgeon's ability will resolve first, regenerating Ornithopter of Paradise. When Prismari Command resolves, the game carries out the instructions in the order written. First, Prismari Command deals 2 damage to Ornithopter of Paradise. The replacement effect generated by the regeneration ability will not apply yet, as even though Ornithopter of Paradise has been dealt lethal damage, it would only be destroyed when state-based actions are checked, and state-based actions are checked when a player would get priority. Next Prismari Command tries to destroy Ornithopter of Paradise and the replacement effect applies, replacing the destruction event with Ornithopter of Paradise being tapped and having all damaged marked on it removed. Lastly Prismari Command finishes resolving and leaves the stack and state-based actions are checked. Since Ornithopter of Paradise no longer has any damage marked on it, it will not be die.

question: Asa controls an [Inventors' Fair], a [Krark-Clan Ironworks], and two [Piston Sledge]. They want to activate the last ability of Inventors' Fair and sacrifice a Piston Sledge to help pay the cost. Is this legal?
answer_gold: Yes. The process for activating an ability is the same as the process for casting a spell. It must be legal to activate the ability in order to put it onto the stack. Mana abilities are only activated after the legality of activating the original ability has been checked.

question: Ahmed controls [Bronze Sable]. They cast [Genesis Wave], putting [Phylactery Lich] and [Solemnity] onto the battlefield. Does Bronze Sable get a phylactery counter?
answer_gold: Yes. Phylactery Lich and Solemnity enter the battlefield at the same time. Solemnity's effect must exist before Phylactery Lich enters the battlefield in order to prevent Bronze Sable from getting a counter.

question: Ashley controls [Tatterkite]. Ashley casts [Genesis Wave], putting [Phylactery Lich] and [Humility] onto the battlefield. Can they put a phylactery counter on Tatterkite?
answer_gold: No. Phylactery Lich and Humility enter the battlefield at the same time. Tatterkite had the ability that prevents it from getting counters immediately before Phylactery Lich entered the battlefield, which is when it matters.

question: Avery controls [The One Ring] and casts [Teferi's Protection] then casts a second The One Ring. What happens at the start of the next turn?
answer_gold: The One Ring will phase back in during the untap step. Then all triggered abilities will go onto the stack, then before Avery gets priority they will have to sacrifice a The One Ring to state-based actions. When the triggers resolve the trigger affiliated with the sacrificed The One Ring will use last known information to determine how many counters were on it, and how much life Avery should lose.

question: Amaya controls [Dralnu, Lich Lord], [Furnace of Rath] and six [Snow-Covered Forest]s. Nico casts [Incinerate] targeting Dralnu, Lich Lord. If Amaya chooses to sacrifice Furnace of Rath, how many other permanents will they need to sacrifice?
answer_gold:
Two or five, Amaya's choice.

Both Dralnu, Lich Lord and Furnace of Rath have replacement effects that modify how the game handles damage that is being dealt to Dralnu, Lich Lord. As Amaya is the controller of the affected object, Amaya will choose which order to apply the replacement effects in. If Amaya chooses to apply Dralnu, Lich Lord's effect first, the 3 damage will be converted into sacrificing three permanents, and Furnace of Rath will no longer apply to that event since there's no longer any damage being dealt. If they chooses to apply Furnace of Rath first, then the three damage will be doubled to six damage, and then will be replaced by sacrificing six permanents.

Whether Amaya chooses to sacrifice Furnace of Rath or not is irrelevant, as all replacement effects are applied to the event before anything is actually sacrificed.

question: Aubrey and Arely are playing 2HG. Aubrey attacks with [Coral Commando] and Arely casts [Flash Conscription] to gain control of Coral Commando after it's been declared as an attacker in the declare attackers step. Is it still attacking?
answer_gold: No. A creature that changes controllers is removed from combat. Even though Aubrey and Arely are on the same team and are both allowed to be attacking with creatures, they are different players and therefore Arely gaining control of Aubrey's creature still qualifies as a control change.

question: Nicolas controls [Razorfield Thresher], [Lake of the Dead], and [Veinfire Borderpost]. Aubrey controls [Omniscience] and casts [Casualties of War], choosing Razorfield Thresher as the artifact target and the creature target. Then they cast [Radiate], targeting Casualties of War. What will be destroyed after all spells and abilities have resolved?
answer_gold: Both Razorfield Thresher and Veinfire Borderpost will be destroyed but no other cards will be destroyed. Once Casualties of War is on the stack, it's a spell with modes that have been locked in, so that the only permanents it can target are artifacts and creatures.

question: Amare controls [Psychogenic Probe] and casts [Pain], targeting Nico. They discard a [Progenitus]. Does Psychogenic Probe trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Progenitus's replacement effect changes the effect of Pain from "Nico discards a card, putting it into their graveyard" to "Nico reveals a card and shuffles it into their library". Pain still caused the shuffle, so Psychogenic Probe triggers.

question: Alonso controls [Spark Double] and casts [Clone]. Alonso would like to have Clone copy Spark Double, then they would like to apply the replacement effect Clone inherited from Spark Double and have it copy Spark Double again. If Alonso has Clone copy Spark Double a total of four times, how many +1/+1 counters will Clone enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: One. Spark Double has a copy effect that includes an exception (entering with a +1/+1 counter). If another copy effect is applied afterwards, the exception from the first effect will not happen.

question: Nickolas controls a [Nyx Herald] enchanted by [Drake Umbra]. Ainsley casts [Fracturing Gust]. How much life do they gain?
answer_gold: Two. There are two different instances of "destroy Drake Umbra" attempting to occur, so Ainsley chooses one of them. Only that one takes place, and only one permanent is destroyed.

question: Avery controls [Corpsejack Menace] and casts [Rescuer Sphinx], choosing to return Corpsejack Menace to their hand. How many +1/+1 counters will Rescuer Sphinx enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Two. Both cards have a replacement effect. Avery will choose whether they are returning a permanent, but won't actually complete the action until Rescuer Sphinx enters the battlefield. Therefore Corpsejack Menace will still apply to the +1/+1 counter being from Rescuer Sphinx's ability.

question: Arabella casts [Mind's Desire]. In response, Neil casts [Lim-Dûl's Vault]. How many copies of Mind's Desire are created when the storm trigger resolves?
answer_gold: 0. The storm trigger only cares about spells cast before the spell that caused it to trigger.

question: Aubrey casts [Bitter Ordeal], targeting Natasha. At their first opportunity, Aubrey sacrifices their [Westvale Abbey]. How many cards will Aubrey be able to exile from Natasha's library?
answer_gold: 2. Gravestorm cares about the number of permanents put into the graveyard before the trigger resolves.

question: Albert controls [Doubling Season] and [Pir, Imaginative Rascal] and activates the +1 ability of [Ajani, Mentor of Heroes]. How many loyalty counters does it gain?
answer_gold:
Four.

Activating a planeswalker ability includes paying the loyalty cost, which in this case means adding one loyalty counter. Doubling Season only replaces effects, which are the result of a spell or ability. However Pir, Imaginative Rascal replaces the original one loyalty counter with two, which Doubling Season can then replace with doubling the additional loyalty counters, resulting in a total of four.

question: Ainsley activates [Priest of Forgotten Gods]'s ability, but doesn't choose a target for the first part. Can Nickolas respond to the ability?
answer_gold: Yes. One of the qualifications for being a mana ability is that the ability doesn't require a target. Priest of Forgotten Gods's ability is still considered to require targets even if zero targets were chosen for it.

question: Analia controls [Volrath's Shapeshifter] and [Muldrotha, the Gravetide], and the top card of their graveyard is [Grid Monitor]. Can Analia cast the Grid Monitor?
answer_gold: No. Analia must be legally allowed to cast a spell in order to begin casting it. None of the exceptions in [601.3] apply here.

question: Antoine owns an [Eternal Scourge] that was exiled by Nico's [Ixalan's Binding]. Can Antoine cast it?
answer_gold: No. Antoine must be legally allowed to cast a spell in order to begin casting it. The exceptions in [601.3] do not apply here.

question: Avery manifests the top card of their library with [Soul Summons]. Then, they mutate [Trumpeting Gnarr] targeting the manifested creature. What are the characteristics of the resulting creature if Avery chooses to put the manifested creature on top?
answer_gold: It is a 2/2 colorless face-down creature with no abilities. It is face-down because the topmost object is face-down, and this status defines its characteristics. This notably means that Trumpeting Gnarr's triggered ability won't trigger.

question: Nayeli controls a [Yixlid Jailer]. Ariel has a [Golgari Brownscale] in their graveyard and returns it to their hand with [Disturbing Plot]. Does Ariel gain 2 life?
answer_gold: No. Golgari Brownscale's trigger cares about the game state immediately before it triggered. At that time it was in the graveyard, and the trigger didn't exist.

question: Aryana has taken control of an [Ahn-Crop Crasher] from Noe with [Tibalt, the Fiend-Blooded], which Aryana exerts. After Aryana ends their turn, will it untap during Noe's untap step?
answer_gold: Yes. A player exerting a permanent only causes it to not untap during that player's next untap step, not any untap step that would untap it.

question: Andres controls [Strionic Resonator] and plays [Clive's Hideaway]. They activate Strionic Resonator targeting the hideaway trigger, exiling 2 cards. On their next turn, they activate Clive's Hideaway's ability to cast the exiled card. What happens as it resolves?
answer_gold: Assuming Andres meets the stated condition, they may cast one or both exiled cards.

question: Aminah has no cards in their library and activate [Words of Wind] in their upkeep. Do they lose the game?
answer_gold: No. Even though there are no there are no cards in Aminah's library and therefore no cards could be drawn, Words of Wind's replacement effect will still apply and replace the draw as normal.

question: Allan controls [Living Inferno]. They activate it, targeting Nathaly's [Runeclaw Bear]. In response, Nathaly casts [Chemister's Trick], targeting the Living Inferno. How much damage will be dealt to Runeclaw Bear when the Living Inferno's ability resolves?
answer_gold: 8. Since Living Inferno divides its damage among multiple targets, Allan announces the division while activating the ability. It won't change later, even if Living Inferno's power changes.

question: After both players finish taking mulligans, Adrian is going second and has both [Gemstone Caverns] and [Chancellor of the Annex] in their hand. Can they reveal Chancellor of the Annex for its ability and also exile it to begin the game with Gemstone Caverns on the battlefield?
answer_gold: Yes. Adrian can choose to use these two card's effects in either order. Therefore they could use Chancellor of the Annex's effect first and then use Gemstone Caverns's.

question: Aspen controls [Cosima, God of the Voyage] and mutates [Snapdax, Apex of the Hunt] onto it, putting it underneath Cosima, God of the Voyage. At the beginning of their next upkeep, Aspen exiles Cosima, God of the Voyage to its own triggered ability. What happens?
answer_gold:
Cosima, God of the Voyage and Snapdax, Apex of the Hunt both get exiled and gain the corresponding triggered ability. 

The ability on Snapdax, Apex of the Hunt still refers to Cosima, God of the Voyage in exile, so whenever a land enters the battlefield under Aspen's control, they can choose to put up to 2 counters on Cosima, God of the Voyage, and if they chooses not to for both triggers, they'll draw twice that many cards.

question: Aubrey controls [Whiskervale Forerunner] and casts [Growth Cycle] to give it +3/+3. Before it resolves, Aubrey casts [Cooperate] choosing to copy Growth Cycle and changes the target to another creature. Does Whiskervale Forerunner trigger again?
answer_gold: No. When copying spells that allow the copies controller to change the target, the targets are changed before the spell is put onto the stack. There is never a point in time where the spell is targeting Whiskervale Forerunner before the targets are changed.

question: Nico has a [Pillarfield Ox] and a [Skullbriar, the Walking Grave] with 3 +1/+1 counters in their graveyard. Arjun casts [Ghastly Conscription], targeting Nico. What happens to the counters on the Skullbriar, the Walking Grave? Will Nico know which manifested card is which?
answer_gold: When in the graveyard, Skullbriar, the Walking Grave had the ability that allowed it to keep its counters, so it is exiled and shuffled with 3 +1/+1 counters. When it's moved to the battlefield, it's face down and no longer has that ability, so the counters cease to exist. It had the counters immediately before entering the battlefield however, so Nico will know which face-down permanent is the Skullbriar, the Walking Grave and which is the Pillarfield Ox.

question: Avery activates [Ascendant Spirit]'s first ability. Before it resolves Avery casts [Slip Out the Back] targeting Ascendant Spirit. When it phases back in, what will it look like?
answer_gold: It will be a 2/2 and not a Warrior. When Ascendant Spirit's ability resolves it's phased out and won't be affected.

question: Aspen controls [Parallel Lives] and a [Caldera Hellion]. They cast [Rite of Replication] targeting the Caldera Hellion. Can Aspen apply the devour replacement effect before the Parallel Lives replacement effect, sacrificing 1 creature to have each token enter with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: No. There are two replacement effects trying to apply to the original event of creating a Caldera Hellion: Caldera Hellion's own effect and Parallel Lives's effect. Caldera Hellion's effect applies to it entering the battlefield however, while Parallel Lives's effect applies to it being created, so Parallel Lives's effect must be applied first. After that is applied the original Caldera Hellion's effect doesn't exist anymore, but each of the new Caldera Hellions entering the battlefield has its own effect, which can now be applied individually.

question: Aubrey controls [Exotic Orchard]. Nikolas controls [Crumbling Vestige]. If Aubrey taps Exotic Orchard, what type(s) of mana can it produce?
answer_gold: Any color. Exotic Orchard checks to see what mana Crumbling Vestige could produce if any of its abilities were to resolve at that time. That includes triggered abilities.

question: Azariah, Beckham, and Caelan are playing a multiplayer game. Beckham controls [Stalking Leonin]. Azariah casts [Worst Fears] to take control of Beckham's next turn. After Beckham begins their turn, can Azariah see which player was chosen for the Stalking Leonin?
answer_gold: No. The choice was made as Stalking Leonin entered the battlefield, which already happened- it's no longer visible to Beckham. Azariah can choose to activate the ability (at which point all players will know who was chosen), but otherwise the choice is not visible to any player.

question: Angela controls [Mirror Gallery] and two [Sakashima the Impostor]s. One is a copy of their [Master of the Hunt]; the other is copying a wolf token created by Master of the Hunt. They attack with all four creatures. What are the possible bands that Angela may declare?
answer_gold: No bands can be declared. The only creature on the battlefield named "Wolves of the Hunt" is the token, so it cannot declare itself as in a band with anything else. The Sakashima the Impostor with "bands with other creatures named Wolves of the Hunt" is not itself named "Wolves of the Hunt", so it cannot declare itself as in a band with the token.

question: Avery controls a Germ token that's equipped with [Barbed Bloodletter]. Nadia controls two [Teferi's Curse]s, one on the Germ, the other on the Barbed Bloodletter. During Avery's untap step, which permanents will phase out? Which of these will phase back in?
answer_gold: All 4 permanents will phase out and phase back in in Ari's next untap step. Barbed Bloodletter and both Teferi's Curses will still be attached to the permanents they were attached to previously. Phasing doesn't cause tokens to cease to exist or unattach permanents from other permanents.

question: Alessandra controls [Sheoldred, the Apocalypse]. During their main phase, they cast [Day's Undoing]. How much life does each player gain/lose?
answer_gold: None. The players first draw seven cards each, triggering Sheoldred, the Apocalypse fourteen times. Then Alessandra ends the turn, which nullifies those triggers before they're even put onto the stack.

question: It is currently day and Adonis controls [Lazotep Convert] (the back face of [Invasion of Amonkhet]), which is a copy of [Kessig Naturalist]. What happens if it becomes night?
answer_gold: Lazotep Convert will be a copy of Kessig Naturalist. As it becomes night, it will not transform and remain a copy of Kessig Naturalist. Lazotep Convert will only copy the front face of Kessig Naturalist and does not copy its status. When it becomes night, it will not transform because a daybound permanent will only transform as it becomes night if it is front face up. ([702.145b])

question: Adelina's [Fireblade Charger] dies, and Nasir responds with [Thwart the Enemy]. Is the damage prevented?
answer_gold: Unclear. Fireblade Charger is not currently a creature on the battlefield, but the game uses its last known information to determine how the damage is dealt. If Fireblade Charger only applies to objects that are creatures, like how Biomantic Mastery only counts creatures that actually exist on the battlefield, it won't be prevented. But if Fireblade Charger checks the source of damage to see whether it's a creature, it will be able to identify the damage as coming from a creature. The intention is probably the latter, but Wizards has not clarified.

question: Aminah casts a [Show and Tell]. As it resolves, Aminah chooses to put a [Haru-Onna] onto the battlefield and Nico chooses to put a [Domestication] onto the battlefield enchanting Haru-Onna. Who controls the enters-the-battlefield ability of Haru-Onna?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. Nico must choose a permanent that is already on the battlefield for the Domestication to enchant. They can't choose a permanent that is entering at the same time.

question:
Amani controls a [Founding the Third Path], and its third ability is resolving. Amani chooses to cast a [Fatal Push] from their graveyard. Amani currently does not have Revolt.
Can Amani choose to target [Skyhunter Patrol] with Fatal Push? Will Skyhunter Patrol be destroyed by Fatal Push?
answer_gold:
Yes Amani can target Skyhunter Patrol, and it will be destroyed by Fatal Push.

Fatal Push does not check for the target's mana value when put on the stack, so Amani is allowed to target Skyhunter Patrol.

Amani will put Fatal Push on the stack as part of the resolution of Founding the Third Path's third chapter. Once the ability is done resolving, SBAs are checked and the saga is sacrificed. In particular this means that Amani will have Revolt when Fatal Push resolves, thus Skyhunter Patrol will get destroyed.

question: Nico controls Analia's [Bane Alley Blackguard] enchanted with their [Corrupted Conscience]. Analia casts their own [Lay Claim], targeting Nico's Corrupted Conscience. After it resolves, who controls the Bane Alley Blackguard? Who controls the Corrupted Conscience?
answer_gold: Analia controls both permanents. Out of the two auras, Corrupted Conscience has the earlier timestamp, and would normally be applied first. However, the effects from both auras apply in the same layer, applying the Lay Claim's effect would change how the Corrupted Conscience's effect is applied, and applying the Corrupted Conscience's effect would not change how the Lay Claim's effect is applied, so the Corrupted Conscience's effect is dependent on the Lay Claim's effect. The Lay Claim's effect applies first, giving Analia control of Corrupted Conscience, and then the Corrupted Conscience's effect applies, giving Analia control of Bane Alley Blackguard.

question: Autumn controls [Traveling Chocobo] and casts [Phyrexian Ingester]. Autumn exiles [Scarwood Goblins] and then [Tor Giant] with the triggers. What are Phyrexian Ingester's power and toughness?
answer_gold:
It's an 8/8.

The enter-the-battlefield ability of Phyrexian Ingester is part of a pair of linked abilities. When determining a value for Phyrexian Ingester's second ability, the sum of the powers and toughnesses from Scarwood Goblins and Tor Giant is used. This gives Phyrexian Ingester +5/+5, which makes it an 8/8.

question: Beverly controls [Pandemonium]. Adalynn casts [Knight Errant] and targets Beverly's [Forest Bear] with the Pandemonium trigger. In response Channing casts [Ral's Outburst] targeting Adalynn causing them to lose the game. Will Beverly's creature die?
answer_gold: The triggered ability of Pandemonium includes a choice to be made upon resolution. However the player that is supposed to make that choice is no longer in the game, therefore the controller of the trigger chooses another player to make that choice. In this case Beverly will choose another player to decide whether Pandemonium's trigger will deal damage to Forest Bear. Beverly is the controller of the trigger since they control the enchantment that generated the trigger, even though Adalynn is the player making choices about the trigger.

question: Asher casts [Show and Tell]. As it resolves, Asher wants to put [Hall of Triumph] onto the battlefield. Do they know what Noa is putting onto the battlefield while making the choice for Hall of Triumph's replacement effect?
answer_gold: Yes. Show and Tell puts both permanents onto the battlefield at the same time. Before they change zones, both players look at each card.

question: Adriel controls [Wandering Ones] equipped with [Fleetfeather Sandals]. On Nico's turn, they enchant it with [Tightening Coils]. On Adriel's next turn, they activate Fleetfeather Sandals's equip ability, targeting Wandering Ones. After that resolves, does it have flying?
answer_gold: No. Tightening Coils has the most recent timestamp, so its effect is applied last. Activating Fleetfeather Sandals's equip ability targeting Wandering Ones doesn't change its timestamp.

question: Ari controls [Bludgeon Brawl] and [Soldevi Digger]. They cast [Titania's Song]. Once it resolves, what are the characteristics of Soldevi Digger?
answer_gold: It's a 2/2 artifact creature with no abilities. Applying Titania's Song would cause Bludgeon Brawl to no longer apply (since Soldevi Digger would be a creature). However, applying Bludgeon Brawl would not change how Titania's Song's effect is applied, so Bludgeon Brawl is dependent on Titania's Song. Titania's Song applies first, and then Bludgeon Brawl won't affect Soldevi Digger since it's a creature.

question: Addilynn activates the Unearth ability of their [Extractor Demon], returning it to the battlefield. Before their end step, Addilynn casts [Reality Ripple] targeting Extractor Demon. What happens to it?
answer_gold: Extractor Demon phases out. When the unearth trigger resolves during Addilynn's end step, it won't be exiled. It will phase back in during Addilynn's next untap step, after which point it will be exiled instead of being put anywhere else if it would leave the battlefield.

question: Avery controls [Vhal, Candlekeep Researcher] and Natalie controls [Verity Circle] and [Koskun Falls]. Avery attacks Natalie with Vhal, Candlekeep Researcher, and then taps it to pay for the cost required by Koskun Falls. Will Natalie's Verity Circle trigger?
answer_gold: No. Verity Circle triggers only if the creature being tapped is not being declared as an attacker. Declaring an attacker is a multi-step process, some of which involve determining costs, activating mana abilities, and paying for costs. Therefore, tapping Vhal, Candlekeep Researcher to pay for the cost required by Koskun Falls is part of declaring it as an attacker.

question: Nico controls [Platinum Emperion]. Alexandra attacks with [Hopeful Eidolon], which Nico doesn't block. Does Alexandra gain life?
answer_gold:
Yes. Damage can have 0 or more results. Normally a creature with lifelink dealing damage to a player would have two results:

* Its controller gains that much life.
* The recipient of the damage loses that much life.

Platinum Emperion makes the second result impossible, so only the first occurs.

question: Ari casts a [Hero of Oxid Ridge]. In response, Nixon casts [Hallow], targeting the Hero of Oxid Ridge. When Ari attacks with the Hero of Oxid Ridge that turn, will the damage be prevented?
answer_gold: Yes. Effects that apply to damage from a spell on the stack continue to apply to damage from the permanent that spell becomes.

question: Ariel wants to participate in a sanctioned Magic tournament, but doesn't know where to find one. To which section of the comprehensive rules should they refer?

Ariel controls [Mycosynth Lattice]. Nora controls [Kaslem's Strider] enchanted with [Spirit Away]. Ariel casts [Opportunistic Dragon] and takes control of Spirit Away. What will happen after Opportunistic Dragon's ability resolves?
answer_gold: Spirit Away will continue to be attached to Kaslem's Strider indefinitely. The "enchant" keyword is a restriction on what an Aura can enchant- without it Spirit Away is legally able to enchant anything.

question: Atlas attacks with [Pristine Angel], and Nico targets it with [Cephalid Snitch] before blockers. After combat, Atlas casts a spell, untapping Pristine Angel. Once untapped, can Nico target it with [Mob]?
answer_gold: Yes. "Protection from all colors" means the same thing as an individual protection ability for each color, so Pristine Angel will lose protection from black while still having protection from all other colors and from artifacts.

question: Ashley controls a [Gaea's Liege] and 1 [Bayou]. Naomi controls a [Reverence] and 3 Bayous. Can Ashley attack with the Gaea's Liege?
answer_gold: No. Checking to see if any restrictions affect a potentially-attacking creature is done before the creature becomes an "attacking creature".

question: Arjun's [Morality Shift] resolves, in what order do they put cards in their graveyard?
answer_gold: In the order of Arjun's choice.

question: Ares controls [Gaea's Cradle] and no creatures. Nico controls a [Contamination]. If Ares taps the Gaea's Cradle, what mana is produced, if any?
answer_gold: No mana is produced. Gaea's Cradle is not producing any mana, so Contamination's replacement effect doesn't apply.

question: Audrey casts [Enlarge] targeting [Goblin Piker], and then attacks with the Goblin Piker. Nico blocks it with a [Baron Sengir], which has gained infect due to their [Grafted Exoskeleton] and indestructible due to their [Withstand Death]. What happens at the end of the turn?
answer_gold: The effect from Enlarge wears off, but the -1/-1 counters on Goblin Piker remain. Goblin Piker dies. It was dealt damage that turn by Baron Sengir, so Baron Sengir triggers.

question: Aubrey controls a [Necromancy] that was cast during their declare blockers step. During Aubrey's end step, Nikolai activates [Duskmantle Guildmage]'s first ability. Does Aubrey lose 1 life when the Necromancy is sacrificed?
answer_gold: Yes. Duskmantle Guildmage creates a delayed triggered ability. The existence of that ability is not a continuous effect, so it still exists during the cleanup step.

question: Alma casts [Virulent Wound], targeting Nico's [Bronze Sable]. In response, Nico casts [Brute Strength] on the Bronze Sable. What happens at the end of the turn?
answer_gold: The effect from Brute Strength wears off, but the -1/-1 counter remains. Bronze Sable dies. The delayed triggered ability created by Virulent Wound is not a continuous effect, so it still exists during the cleanup step, and will trigger due to Bronze Sable dying. Nico gets a poison counter.

question: Angelina controls [Ice Cauldron]. Noel controls [Suppression Field]. Angelina activates Ice Cauldron's first ability with X=1, paying {C}{C}{C}. On Angelina's next turn, they activate Ice Cauldron's second ability. How much mana do they add?
answer_gold: Just {C}. The activation cost of Ice Cauldron's first ability is "{X}, {T}". The additional cost imposed by Suppression Field is not part of the activation cost, and the mana spent on it isn't noted when the ability resolves.

question: Ariel activates [Warped Landscape]. Before that resolves Noe casts [Aven Mindcensor]. When Ariel is resolving Warped Landscape's ability, they find [Panglacial Wurm] in the top four cards of their library. Can they cast it?
answer_gold: Yes. Aven Mindcensor's ability is a replacement effect that replaces searching a library with searching only the top four cards of that library. However for the purposes of Panglacial Wurm's effect, it still qualifies as "searching a library".

question: Addison has cast a sideboard card from [Glittering Wish], which is now in their graveyard. Addison then restarts the game with [Karn Liberated]. What happens?
answer_gold: The sideboard card is shuffled into Addison's library for the restarted game.

question: Alvin controls [Mycosynth Lattice], a [Dance of the Dead] attached to a [Streetbreaker Wurm] that it returned to the battlefield, and a [Mizzium Transreliquat] that is currently a copy of [Sakashima of a Thousand Faces] due to its second ability. Alvin casts [Eureka], choosing to put [March of the Machines] onto the battlefield, then putting [Copy Artifact] onto the battlefield, which copies the Mizzium Transreliquat and then copies the Dance of the Dead with its new copy ability. (The one from Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.) They choose for it to enchant a [Viashino Warrior] in their graveyard. As Eureka continues resolving, they put [Shimatsu the Bloodcloaked] onto the battlefield and sacrifice March of the Machines. After Copy Artifact's trigger resolves and returns the Viashino Warrior to the battlefield, Alvin activates the ability of the Copy Artifact to turn it into a copy of Streetbreaker Wurm. What happens?
answer_gold: The Copy Artifact becomes unattached from the Viashino Warrior. It still has the ability "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Dance of the Dead", but it's not an Aura so nothing happens to it if it isn't enchanting a legal object. If Copy Artifact leaves the battlefield later, Alvin will have to sacrifice Viashino Warrior.

question: Aspen controls a [Blood Tyrant] that they took control of from Briella using [Malevolent Whispers]. Aspen has 1 life. Cason casts [Volt Charge] targeting Aspen. After it resolves and Aspen loses the game, will Blood Tyrant get the +1/+1 counters?
answer_gold: No. As Aspen loses the game, the effect granting them control of Blood Tyrant ends, and it returns to Briella. "Loses the game" triggers use the game state immediately before they triggered to determine how that trigger is handled. Since Aspen controlled Blood Tyrant right before losing the game, the trigger would be placed onto the stack under their control. However Aspen is no longer in the game when the trigger would be placed onto the stack, so it never is.

question: Aspen, Brycen, and Collins begin a multiplayer game. In Aspen's upkeep, they use [Leyline of Anticipation], several [Simian Spirit Guide]s and [Desperate Ritual]s, and [Goblin Charbelcher] to kill Brycen. Does Aspen draw a card for the turn?
answer_gold: Yes. The game began with more than 2 players, so it is a multiplayer game, regardless of the current number of players remaining.. Aspen will draw a card during their draw step.

question: Addison, Brixton, and Collins started playing a multiplayer game. Collins lost the game, and then Addison restarted the game with [Karn Liberated]. Will Addison draw a card on the first turn of the restarted game?
answer_gold: No. The game began with 2 players, so it is a two-player game.. Addison will skip their draw step.

question: Aniyah casts [Martyrdom], targeting their [Douser of Lights]. After it resolves, Nico takes control of Douser of Lights with [Act of Aggression]. Can Nico activate the ability it gained from Martyrdom?
answer_gold: Yes. "Only you may activate this ability." is an activation instruction for the ability, and it is part of the ability gained by the Douser of Lights. "You" therefore refers to the permanent's current controller.

question: Ashley has restarted the game with a [Karn Liberated] that exiled an [Ajani's Chosen]. Ashley chooses to begin the restarted game with a [Leyline of Anticipation] on the battlefield. Does Ajani's Chosen trigger?
answer_gold: No. Leyline of Anticipation is put onto the battlefield before the Ajani's Chosen is.

question: Nehemiah controls a [Skullbriar, the Walking Grave] with 2 +1/+1 counters on it. Ari casts [Bishop of Binding], exiling the Skullbriar, the Walking Grave. When Ari attacks with Bishop of Binding on their next turn, what will X equal in Bishop of Binding's triggered ability?
answer_gold: 3. +1/+1 counters on cards in exile do affect their power and toughness. X is determined only once, as the effect begins to apply, so it does take into account the final power of the exiled card.

question: Neriah controls a [Containment Priest] and has a [Knotvine Mystic] in their graveyard. Alan casts [Ghastly Conscription], targeting Neriah. What happens to the Knotvine Mystic?
answer_gold: Rather than entering the battlefield, it is exiled. It was turned face down before it was put onto the battlefield, but it then becomes a new object with no relation to its previous existence. It will remain in exile face up.

question: Niko has a [Skullbriar, the Walking Grave] in their graveyard with 2 +1/+1 counters on it. Ashley controls [Containment Priest], and casts [Ghastly Conscription], targeting Niko. What happens?
answer_gold: In order for counters to remain on Skullbriar, the Walking Grave, it needs to have that ability immediately before it changes zones. It did have that ability in the graveyard, so it is exiled face down with the +1/+1 counters remaining on it during that change. It then attempts to enter the battlefield, but remains in exile instead due to Containment Priest. Since it becomes a new object, it will be face-up in exile. However it didn't change zones, so the counters will remain on it in exile.

question: Avery controls [Magnetic Web] and is attacking with two [Leatherback Baloth]s with magnet counters on them. Nayeli controls one [Imperial Moth] that also has a magnet counter on it. What are Nayeli's legal blocks?
answer_gold: Nayeli can block either Leatherback Baloth with their Magnetic Web. When declaring blockers, Nayeli must fulfill the maximum number of requirements, while not violating any restrictions.

question: Arden controls [Naga Vitalist] and a [Deathrite Shaman] that's currently a land due to [Xenograft] (naming "Saproling") and [Life and Limb]. Neither player has any land cards in their graveyards. If Arden taps Naga Vitalist, what type(s) of mana can it produce?
answer_gold: Any color. Naga Vitalist checks to see what mana Deathrite Shaman could produce if any of its abilities were to resolve at that time. If Deathrite Shaman's first ability were to resolve now it would produce any color of mana. It doesn't matter that it has no legal targets and couldn't resolve, since the check in [106.7] takes it resolving as a premise.

question: Ashley controls [Skill Borrower] and [Sensei's Divining Top]. The top card of their library is a [Putrid Leech]. Ashley activates Skill Borrower's ability, then activates Sensei's Divining Top's first ability, choosing to put Putrid Leech second from the top. Then they activate Sensei's Divining Top again, putting Putrid Leech back on top. Can Ashley activate Skill Borrower's ability again?
answer_gold: Yes. Putrid Leech stopped being revealed for a time, so it is no longer the same object that it was before. Skill Borrower has a new ability that just has the same text as the ability that was activated earlier.

question: Adelyn controls [Panharmonicon] and [Mycosynth Lattice] and has [Dwarven Trader] and [Staunch Shieldmate] in their graveyard. They cast [Animate Dead] targeting Dwarven Trader. What happens as it enters the battlefield?
answer_gold: Animate Dead enters the battlefield attached to Dwarven Trader and triggers twice. The first trigger will return Dwarven Trader to the battlefield. The second trigger just does the same things again, so it has no relevant result.

question: Armani controls a [Gaea's Liege] and 3 [Canopy Vista]s. Nico controls a [Reverence] and 1 Canopy Vista. Can Armani attack with the Gaea's Liege?
answer_gold: Yes. Checking to see if any restrictions affect a potentially-attacking creature is done before the creature becomes an "attacking creature".

question: Ariel attacks with [Wildfire Eternal], which isn't blocked. As the trigger resolves, can they choose to suspend [Charnel Serenade]?
answer_gold:
Yes. The suspend special action can be taken whenever Charnel Serenade could be cast from Ariel's hand. Normally that's only when Ariel has priority on their turn with an empty stack, but in this case the effect of Wildfire Eternal is letting that happen while the ability resolves.

(They still have to pay the suspend cost, and afterwards they can choose to cast a different spell from hand without paying its mana cost.)

question: Brynn has 1 life and controls a phased-out [Fairgrounds Warden] that exiled Coleman's [Alpha Tyrranax]. Aspen casts [Psychic Purge], targeting Brynn. What happens as Brynn loses the game?
answer_gold: All objects owned by Brynn leave the game. However the game treats phased-out permanents as nonexistent, and does not see the leaves-the-battlefield event happen. Alpha Tyrranax will not return to the battlefield.

question: Avery controls [Caelorna, Coral Tyrant] and [Darksteel Garrison] that's fortifying [Spire Garden]. Avery casts [Bludgeon Brawl]. After that resolves they activate Darksteel Garrison's equip ability targeting Caelorna, Coral Tyrant. What does the battlefield look like after that ability has resolved and state-based actions have been checked?
answer_gold:
Darksteel Garrison is attached to Caelorna, Coral Tyrant and not to Spire Garden.

Bludgeon Brawl doesn't specify that the permanents it affects keep their original subtypes, so they are overwritten. This means that Darksteel Garrison ceases to be a Fortification as soon as Bludgeon Brawl enters the battlefield. It will become unattached the next time state-based actions are performed. When its equip ability resolves, it becomes attached to Caelorna, Coral Tyrant.

question: Noah controls a [Mons's Goblin Raiders] enchanted with a [Spider Umbra]. Alexandra casts [Yamabushi's Flame], targeting Mons's Goblin Raiders. What happens?
answer_gold:
Spider Umbra is destroyed and Mons's Goblin Raiders remains on the battlefield.

There are two replacement effects trying to apply to the same event. Umbra armor is attempting to replace the destruction of the creature, while Yamabushi's Flame's effect is attempting to replace where the creature moves to. The "move to the graveyard" event is a part of the "destroy" event, so the umbra armor replacement effect must apply first. Once that effect has been applied, the creature is no longer about to die, so there are no more effects to apply.

If the Mons's Goblin Raiders would die later in the turn, the Yamabushi's Flame's replacement effect will apply at that time and cause it to move to exile instead of the graveyard.

question: Abel attacks with [Pristine Angel]. While it's tapped, Nico activates [Cephalid Snitch]'s ability targeting Pristine Angel. After that resolves, Abel casts a spell and untaps Pristine Angel. Can Nico now target the Pristine Angel with [Murder]?
answer_gold:
Yes. "Protection from all colors" is shorthand for protection from each color individually. It loses protection from black, and still has protection from all the other colors.

(The timestamp of Pristine Angel's ability does not change when it becomes untapped.)

question: At the beginning of the game, Alex announced [Kaheera, the Orphanguard] as their companion. During the game, Alex cast [Carrion Grub] from their sideboard with [Wish]. Later, Alex restarts the game with [Karn Liberated]. What happens?
answer_gold: Carrion Grub will be shuffled into Alex's library along with the rest of the cards in the game. Because Carrion Grub violates Kaheera, the Orphanguard's companion restriction, Alex can't announce it as their companion for the restarted game.

question: Adelyn controls [Back from the Brink] and has [Shifting Wall] in their graveyard. Can Adelyn activate Back from the Brink's ability to create a token of Shifting Wall? Can they pay more than {0} to do so? If so, will it enter the battlefield with any +1/+1 counters?
answer_gold: Adelyn may activate the ability of Shifting Wall paying {0}. He does not have the ability to pay more than {0}. The token will not enter the battlefield with any +1/+1 counters.

question: Alex controls a [Krark-Clan Ironworks], a [Mycosynth Lattice], and a [Control Magic] that took control of a [Boris Devilboon] from Nico. Alex begins activating the ability of Boris Devilboon and sacrifices Control Magic to help pay the cost. Is this legal? If so, who will control the ability?
answer_gold:
Yes, this is legal, and Alex will control the ability. The process for activating an ability is the same as the process for casting a spell. The first step of activating an ability is to put it onto the stack. Mana abilities are activated in a later step. The ability is already on the stack at this point (controlled by Alex), so the Boris Devilboon changing controllers won't change who controls the ability. After activating mana abilities, Alex must pay the activation cost. {T} means "tap this permanent", so Alex can pay the cost regardless of who controls the Boris Devilboon at that time.

Legality is checked before mana abilities are activated, so it won't matter that Boris Devilboon gets summoning sickness when it changes controllers.

question: Nico has cast a [Gather Specimens] earlier in the turn. Aiden controls a [Chronatog Totem] that is currently a creature due to its own ability, and casts an [Evil Twin], choosing to have it copy Chronatog Totem. What happens?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. As Evil Twin begins to resolve, Nico gains control of it before any other choices are made. Nico will make the choice of what to copy as it enters the battlefield.

question: Albert and Nico are beginning the game and have just drawn 7 cards. Albert has [Serum Powder] in their hand. Does Albert get to know whether Nico is going to mulligan before deciding whether to use Serum Powder's ability?
answer_gold: No. Albert exiles their hand and draws 7 cards at the time they would normally declare if they are going to take a mulligan, which is before Nico has made that decision.

question: Ariana controls [Sen Triplets], which targeted Nico. Nico's hand contains [Rift Sower]. Can either player suspend it? If so, who will cast it once the last time counter is removed?
answer_gold: Neither player can suspend it. Only a card's owner has the option to suspend it, and only if they have permission to cast it.

question: Ariella controls a manifested [Wayward Angel] and has 7 cards in their graveyard. Nathaniel casts [Turn to Frog], targeting Wayward Angel. After that resolves, Ariella turns Wayward Angel face up. What are Wayward Angel's characteristics afterwards?
answer_gold: It's a 4/4 black Frog with trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature", but no other abilities. Wayward Angel receives a new timestamp when it turns face up, so its ability is applied before Turn to Frog in each layer. Wayward Angel's last ability is removed by Turn to Frog in layer 6, but since it's already started to apply in layer 5 to change its color to black, it will continue doing so in later layers. Turn to Frog has the earlier timestamp, so it makes Wayward Angel blue before it becomes black in layer 5 and removes Wayward Angel's abilities in layer 6 before it gains trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature".

question: Ahmad controls [Conspiracy] (naming "Ferret"), [Kormus Bell], [Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth], and a [Vastwood Zendikon] enchanting Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth that entered the battlefield in that order. Is Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth a creature? If so, what are its creature types?
answer_gold: It is an Elemental Ferret creature. Conspiracy has the earliest timestamp, but it's dependent on Vastwood Zendikon, and waits to apply until after Vastwood Zendikon is applied. Kormus Bell is dependent on Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth, so Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth is applied first, then Kormus Bell. At this point Conspiracy is no longer be dependent on Vastwood Zendikon, so Conspiracy is applied, and then Vastwood Zendikon. Since Vastwood Zendikon says that Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth is still a land, it retains its prior creature type of "Ferret" when it becomes an Elemental.
